description: This file contains the PHP class 'OrderStatus' which is part of the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation' namespace. The class provides methods for managing order statuses, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving order status data from a database.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: A model class providing CRUD operations for order status management within the Opencart admin localization namespace.

methods.name: addOrderStatus
methods.description: Adds a new order status for multiple languages, storing the status explanation in the database.

methods.name: editOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing order status and its descriptions across languages.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatus
methods.description: Deletes a specific order status from the database.

methods.name: deleteOrderStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all order statuses associated with a particular language ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves an order status record based on its ID.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of order statuses, optionally filtered and sorted according to provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOrderStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of order statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds or updates the description (name) of an order status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches the descriptions for a given order status across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all order status descriptions for a specified language ID.
